title: Manufacturing ontology
description: Portable manufacturing semantics imported from the Lattice industry ontology.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Ontology
metadata:
  name: manufacturing
  title: Manufacturing Ontology
  description: Shared product, supplier, procurement, receiving, inspection, and quality semantics.
  version: 0.1.0
  source:
    system: lattice
    sourceId: manufacturing-ontology
    sourceVersion: 0.1.0
    sourceDigest: sha256:b5a9bfad2a50a504903baf93be8d955d6f9120e595ff14821d41a0b274370769
spec:
  types:
    - id: part_material
      label: Part or Material
      description: A governed component, material, or finished part.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0
      properties:
        - id: part_material.part_number
          label: Part Number
          description: Affected part number.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/0
        - id: part_material.component_items
          label: Component Items
          description: Component list with part number, quantity, unit, revision, and scrap factor.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/1
        - id: part_material.material_name
          label: Material Name
          description: Material or product name.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/2
        - id: part_material.parent_part_number
          label: Parent Part Number
          description: Parent assembly or finished good part number.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/3
        - id: part_material.lot_number
          label: Lot Number
          description: Lot, batch, heat, or serial number.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/4
        - id: part_material.commodity_category
          label: Commodity Category
          description: Commodity, material group, or category.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/5
        - id: part_material.parent_part_description
          label: Parent Part Description
          description: Parent part description.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/6
        - id: part_material.part_or_material_number
          label: Part Or Material Number
          description: Part, material, or item number.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/7
        - id: part_material.part_revision
          label: Part Revision
          description: Part revision.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/8
        - id: part_material.specification_standard
          label: Specification Standard
          description: Specification or standard referenced.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/9
    - id: supplier
      label: Supplier
      description: An organization supplying parts, material, or services.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1
      properties:
        - id: supplier.supplier_name
          label: Supplier Name
          description: Supplier or manufacturer.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/0
        - id: supplier.supplier_or_work_center
          label: Supplier Or Work Center
          description: Supplier or internal work center.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/1
        - id: supplier.supplier_id
          label: Supplier Id
          description: Supplier identifier.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/2
        - id: supplier.supplier_tier
          label: Supplier Tier
          description: Preferred, approved, conditional, probation, disqualified, or other tier.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/3
    - id: purchase_order
      label: Purchase Order
      description: An authorized commitment to purchase goods or services.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2
      properties:
        - id: purchase_order.purchase_order_number
          label: Purchase Order Number
          description: Purchase order number.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/0
        - id: purchase_order.buyer_name
          label: Buyer Name
          description: Buying legal entity or plant.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/1
        - id: purchase_order.line_items
          label: Line Items
          description: PO line items with part, description, quantity, unit price, and due date.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/2
        - id: purchase_order.line_items_received
          label: Line Items Received
          description: Received line items with part, quantity ordered, quantity received, and disposition.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/3
        - id: purchase_order.on_time_delivery_rate
          label: On Time Delivery Rate
          description: On-time delivery rate percentage.
          dataType: decimal
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/4
        - id: purchase_order.po_date
          label: Po Date
          description: Date the purchase order was issued.
          dataType: date
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/5
        - id: purchase_order.total_amount
          label: Total Amount
          description: Total purchase order amount.
          dataType: decimal
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/6
        - id: purchase_order.buyer_contact_name
          label: Buyer Contact Name
          description: Buyer contact or purchasing agent.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/7
        - id: purchase_order.incoterms
          label: Incoterms
          description: Incoterms or freight terms.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/8
        - id: purchase_order.payment_terms
          label: Payment Terms
          description: Payment terms.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/9
        - id: purchase_order.requested_delivery_date
          label: Requested Delivery Date
          description: Requested delivery date.
          dataType: date
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/10
        - id: purchase_order.ship_to_location
          label: Ship To Location
          description: Ship-to plant, warehouse, or address.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/11
        - id: purchase_order.subtotal_amount
          label: Subtotal Amount
          description: Subtotal amount.
          dataType: decimal
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/12
        - id: purchase_order.tax_amount
          label: Tax Amount
          description: Tax amount.
          dataType: decimal
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/13
    - id: receiving_record
      label: Receiving Record
      description: A record of goods received against a purchase commitment.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3
      properties:
        - id: receiving_record.line_items_received
          label: Line Items Received
          description: Received line items with part, quantity ordered, quantity received, and disposition.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/0
        - id: receiving_record.receipt_date
          label: Receipt Date
          description: Date goods were received.
          dataType: date
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/1
        - id: receiving_record.receiving_report_number
          label: Receiving Report Number
          description: Receiving report or goods receipt number.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/2
        - id: receiving_record.carrier_name
          label: Carrier Name
          description: Carrier or freight provider.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/3
        - id: receiving_record.hold_status
          label: Hold Status
          description: Released, on hold, rejected, pending inspection, or other status.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/4
        - id: receiving_record.packing_slip_number
          label: Packing Slip Number
          description: Supplier packing slip number.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/5
        - id: receiving_record.received_by
          label: Received By
          description: Receiving employee or function.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/6
        - id: receiving_record.shortage_or_overage
          label: Shortage Or Overage
          description: Shortage, overage, or mismatch summary.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/7
    - id: quality_inspection
      label: Quality Inspection
      description: A governed inspection of material or product characteristics.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4
      properties:
        - id: quality_inspection.disposition
          label: Disposition
          description: Scrap, rework, repair, use-as-is, return to supplier, or other disposition.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/0
        - id: quality_inspection.inspection_characteristics
          label: Inspection Characteristics
          description: Measured characteristics with specification, result, and disposition.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/1
        - id: quality_inspection.inspection_date
          label: Inspection Date
          description: Inspection date.
          dataType: date
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/2
        - id: quality_inspection.inspection_report_number
          label: Inspection Report Number
          description: Inspection report number.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/3
        - id: quality_inspection.overall_disposition
          label: Overall Disposition
          description: Accepted, rejected, rework, use-as-is, or other disposition.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/4
        - id: quality_inspection.coa_disposition
          label: Coa Disposition
          description: Conforms, accepted, rejected, or other disposition.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/5
        - id: quality_inspection.defect_count
          label: Defect Count
          description: Count of defects found.
          dataType: integer
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/6
        - id: quality_inspection.inspection_required
          label: Inspection Required
          description: Whether quality inspection is required.
          dataType: boolean
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/7
        - id: quality_inspection.inspector_name
          label: Inspector Name
          description: Inspector name.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/8
        - id: quality_inspection.sample_size
          label: Sample Size
          description: Sample size inspected.
          dataType: integer
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/9
    - id: nonconformance
      label: Nonconformance
      description: A deviation from an approved specification or process.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5
      properties:
        - id: nonconformance.ncr_date
          label: Ncr Date
          description: Date the nonconformance was opened.
          dataType: date
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/0
        - id: nonconformance.ncr_number
          label: Ncr Number
          description: Nonconformance report number.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/1
        - id: nonconformance.nonconformance_description
          label: Nonconformance Description
          description: Description of nonconformance.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/2
        - id: nonconformance.root_cause
          label: Root Cause
          description: Root cause.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/3
        - id: nonconformance.closure_date
          label: Closure Date
          description: Closure date.
          dataType: date
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/4
        - id: nonconformance.containment_actions
          label: Containment Actions
          description: Containment actions taken.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/5
        - id: nonconformance.mrb_owner
          label: Mrb Owner
          description: Material review board owner or approver.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/6
        - id: nonconformance.nonconformance_count
          label: Nonconformance Count
          description: Number of nonconformances.
          dataType: integer
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/7
        - id: nonconformance.quantity_affected
          label: Quantity Affected
          description: Quantity affected.
          dataType: decimal
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/8
        - id: nonconformance.root_cause_summary
          label: Root Cause Summary
          description: Root cause summary if known.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/9
    - id: corrective_action
      label: Corrective and Preventive Action
      description: A governed action plan that corrects causes and prevents recurrence.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/6
      properties:
        - id: corrective_action.capa_number
          label: Capa Number
          description: CAPA number.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/6/properties/0
        - id: corrective_action.owner_name
          label: Owner Name
          description: CAPA owner.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/6/properties/1
        - id: corrective_action.target_completion_date
          label: Target Completion Date
          description: Target completion date.
          dataType: date
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/6/properties/2
        - id: corrective_action.capa_status
          label: Capa Status
          description: Open, implemented, pending effectiveness, closed, overdue, or other status.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/6/properties/3
        - id: corrective_action.corrective_actions
          label: Corrective Actions
          description: Corrective actions.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/6/properties/4
        - id: corrective_action.corrective_actions_open
          label: Corrective Actions Open
          description: Open corrective actions.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/6/properties/5
        - id: corrective_action.effectiveness_check_plan
          label: Effectiveness Check Plan
          description: Effectiveness check plan.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/6/properties/6
        - id: corrective_action.effectiveness_due_date
          label: Effectiveness Due Date
          description: Effectiveness check due date.
          dataType: date
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/6/properties/7
        - id: corrective_action.mrb_owner
          label: Mrb Owner
          description: Material review board owner or approver.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/6/properties/8
        - id: corrective_action.preventive_actions
          label: Preventive Actions
          description: Preventive actions.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/6/properties/9
        - id: corrective_action.review_owner
          label: Review Owner
          description: Owner of supplier review.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/6/properties/10
    - id: bill_of_materials
      label: Bill of Materials
      description: A versioned definition of components required for a parent part.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/7
      properties:
        - id: bill_of_materials.bom_number
          label: Bom Number
          description: BOM number or identifier.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/7/properties/0
        - id: bill_of_materials.bom_revision
          label: Bom Revision
          description: BOM revision level.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/7/properties/1
        - id: bill_of_materials.parent_part_number
          label: Parent Part Number
          description: Parent assembly or finished good part number.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/7/properties/2
        - id: bill_of_materials.bom_status
          label: Bom Status
          description: Released, draft, obsolete, pending, or other status.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/7/properties/3
        - id: bill_of_materials.engineering_change_order
          label: Engineering Change Order
          description: Related engineering change order.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/7/properties/4
        - id: bill_of_materials.parent_part_description
          label: Parent Part Description
          description: Parent part description.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/7/properties/5
        - id: bill_of_materials.part_revision
          label: Part Revision
          description: Part revision.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/7/properties/6
    - id: person
      label: Person
      description: A human being identified in a governed business context.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/8
      properties:
        - id: person.person_id
          label: Person identifier
          description: Stable governed identifier for the person.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/8/properties/0
        - id: person.display_name
          label: Display name
          description: Preferred name used in governed interfaces.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/8/properties/1
        - id: person.effective_from
          label: Effective from
          description: Time from which this person record is valid.
          dataType: datetime
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/8/properties/2
    - id: organization
      label: Organization
      description: A governed legal, public, or operating organization.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/9
      properties:
        - id: organization.organization_id
          label: Organization identifier
          description: Stable governed identifier for the organization.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/9/properties/0
        - id: organization.legal_name
          label: Legal name
          description: Registered or otherwise authoritative organization name.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/9/properties/1
        - id: organization.organization_type
          label: Organization type
          description: Governed classification of the organization.
          dataType: string
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/9/properties/2
    - id: agent
      label: Agent
      description: A human or software actor authorized to perform governed activity.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/10
      properties:
        - id: agent.agent_id
          label: Agent identifier
          description: Stable governed identifier for the actor.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/10/properties/0
        - id: agent.agent_type
          label: Agent type
          description: Whether the actor is human, service, or automated.
          dataType: string
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/10/properties/1
        - id: agent.active
          label: Active
          description: Whether the agent is currently authorized.
          dataType: boolean
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/10/properties/2
    - id: location
      label: Location
      description: A physical, administrative, or virtual place relevant to governed activity.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/11
      properties:
        - id: location.location_id
          label: Location identifier
          description: Stable governed identifier for the location.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/11/properties/0
        - id: location.name
          label: Location name
          description: Human-readable location name.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/11/properties/1
        - id: location.country_code
          label: Country code
          description: ISO country code when applicable.
          dataType: string
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/11/properties/2
    - id: document
      label: Document
      description: A governed information artifact with identity, version, and provenance.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/12
      properties:
        - id: document.document_id
          label: Document identifier
          description: Stable governed identifier for the document.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/12/properties/0
        - id: document.title
          label: Title
          description: Authoritative document title.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/12/properties/1
        - id: document.version
          label: Version
          description: Document version or revision.
          dataType: string
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/12/properties/2
        - id: document.issued_at
          label: Issued at
          description: Time at which the document was issued.
          dataType: datetime
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/12/properties/3
    - id: event
      label: Event
      description: A governed occurrence bounded by time and business meaning.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/13
      properties:
        - id: event.event_id
          label: Event identifier
          description: Stable governed identifier for the event.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/13/properties/0
        - id: event.event_type
          label: Event type
          description: Governed classification of the event.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/13/properties/1
        - id: event.occurred_at
          label: Occurred at
          description: Time at which the event occurred.
          dataType: datetime
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/13/properties/2
    - id: asset
      label: Asset
      description: A governed physical, digital, or financial resource.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/14
      properties:
        - id: asset.asset_id
          label: Asset identifier
          description: Stable governed identifier for the asset.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/14/properties/0
        - id: asset.name
          label: Asset name
          description: Human-readable asset name.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/14/properties/1
        - id: asset.asset_type
          label: Asset type
          description: Governed classification of the asset.
          dataType: string
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/14/properties/2
    - id: policy
      label: Policy
      description: A versioned rule or standard governing decisions and actions.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/15
      properties:
        - id: policy.policy_id
          label: Policy identifier
          description: Stable governed identifier for the policy.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/15/properties/0
        - id: policy.title
          label: Policy title
          description: Authoritative policy title.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/15/properties/1
        - id: policy.version
          label: Version
          description: Approved policy version.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/15/properties/2
        - id: policy.effective_from
          label: Effective from
          description: Time from which the policy applies.
          dataType: datetime
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/15/properties/3
    - id: logistics_provider
      label: Logistics provider
      description: Provides shipping and logistics
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/16
      properties: []
  relationships:
    - id: supplied_by
      label: SUPPLIED_BY
      description: Part Material supplied by Supplier.
      sourceTypeId: part_material
      targetTypeId: supplier
      cardinality: many-to-many
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/0
    - id: orders
      label: ORDERS
      description: Purchase Order orders Part Material.
      sourceTypeId: purchase_order
      targetTypeId: part_material
      cardinality: many-to-many
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/1
    - id: fulfilled_by
      label: FULFILLED_BY
      description: Purchase Order fulfilled by Receiving Record.
      sourceTypeId: purchase_order
      targetTypeId: receiving_record
      cardinality: many-to-many
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/2
